newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commission President Jacques Santer had made a statement that he was confident France would pursue its action in favour of European integration and respect the IGC and EMU calendars.
In answer to a question, van der Pas said Santer had no reason to have any doubt France's new majority would apply the Maastricht Treaty since it had originally been negotiated by the socialists.

Asked about the consequences of a new majority in France on the social negotiations on information and consultaion at national level, spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said the Commission would continue its work independently from new French majority's actions.
Van der Pas said Santer had never lost hope that the Confidence Pact on jobs would be adopted and that the pact would be on the Amsterdam European Council agenda.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/466: Inaugural session of the European Forum on 5 June: "A commitment for the future".
- IP/97/469: EU ministers back better access for world's poorest countries.
- Speech/97/126: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on "current pressures on the CAP - the way forward".
- Speech/97/127: Summary of speeches by Commissioner Anita Gradin on equal opportunities.
